profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer at Microsoft AI, working on the Edge browser

Added unique histograms, de-duped existing histograms and added new metrics for Microsoft AI features and campaigns. Created data pipelines and dashboards to track and present impact. Created and maintained automated pipelines to generate a daily metrics funnel summary email, sent to entire organization. Migrated team's backend data pipelines to new data processing system, validating against old pipeline outputs. Onboarded over 50 partner teams to team's new triggering framework, as well as adding performance and status telemetry to monitor framework. Enabled experimentation and improved framework performance through code optimizations. Resolved bugs, including accessibility bugs, and crashes in team feature areas.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Work on tasks and bugs for both front end and back end in Typescript, React and C++. Closed 8 pull requests that add code changes to Edge browser codebase, shipping to millions of users. Regular syncing with program manager and feature designer. Daily collaboration with engineers on own Shell Integration team. Expanding knowledge of codebase and ramping up via pair programming, conducting code reviews of team members' pull requests, consulting Microsoft help channels, self-study of team languages and communication with React WebUI Help and Engineering System on Teams.

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
Highly selective female and gender-diverse software engineering program comprised of 6 months of full-time classroom training, followed by 5 months in a paid industry internship. 
Topics covered: Ruby, Rails, Javascript, React, Web APIs, HTML, CSS, Computer Science Fundamentals, Test-Driven Development, Pair Programming, Agile Practices.

positions.title: International E-Commerce Manager
positions.description: Oversaw online sales channels for startup producing reusable glass straws in Germany. Launched product in USA marketplace. Created enhanced brand content that increased product conversion rate. Conducted market research to optimize product listings for each European marketplace. Forecast sales and collaborated with logistics to maintain product inventory levels.

positions.title: Consultant, Ashoka Globalizer: Qualitative Research, Writing, Event Support
positions.description: Interviewed 16 Ashoka Fellows (social entrepreneurs) worldwide by phone to examine the professional impact of their participation in a Globalizer Summit. Analyzed interviews to measure the Summit’s effect and identified patterns within the data set. Drafted the impact assessment report by compiling interviews into cohesive narratives. Assisted with logistics for Globalizer Summits in Buenos Aires, AR (63 attendees).

positions.title: Intern, Ashoka Globalizer: Content Creation, Editing, Event Support
positions.description:
ASApreneur Internship, a one-year qualification program developing leadership competencies for sustainable international development. Funded by BMZ with a 3 month placement in Lima, Peru. 

Wrote press releases, event materials and conference reports. Drafted article published in ReVista Harvard Review of Latin America. Edited grant proposals, knowledge product presentations and website content. Supported Globalizer summits in Bonn, DE (45 attendees) and Bogotá, CO (67 attendees) event logistics: drafted, edited and coordinated printed materials, communicated in Spanish to arrange hotel and restaurant bookings, collaborated with local team, coordinated flights and visas.

positions.title: Merchant Risk Investigator
positions.description: Identified fraud patterns on European and American merchant accounts. Quantified seller accounts’ financial risk to Amazon.com by analyzing seller performance metrics. Communicated account status to sellers in English, German and French. Liaised with internal departments as well as account managers worldwide regarding seller performance. Executed independent decision-making regarding the closure and re-opening of high-volume seller accounts. Coached high-volume sellers in improving seller performance.

positions.title: Project Manager and Grant Recipient
positions.description: Team received a $10,000 competitive grant to construct a well in Borena, Ethiopia. Coordinated partnership with Oxfam International. Drafted plan to facilitate local participation in construction. Created and executed a workshop in entrepreneurship education. Fundraised additional $7,000 for project implementation.

positions.title: Campus Kiva Resource Coordinator
positions.description: Educated students about the potential impact of microfinance and encouraged micro-lending. Supported development of Campus Kiva educational platform. Provided chapters with information and resources.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Student/Faculty Collaborative Researcher in the Economics Department. Supported Professor in researching and developing an evolutionary game theoretical model.

positions.title: Critical Infrastructure and Homeland Security Policy Intern
positions.description: Researched regional developments in infrastructure, security and economic growth. Worked with legislators and academics in Canada and the U.S. to draft newsletters sent to over 1,000 regional stakeholders. Assisted in planning logistics of Annual Summit with over 600 attendees and managed 30 volunteers while on-site.

positions.title: U.S. ImagineNetwork Program Coordinator Intern
positions.description: Researched emerging industries in Africa and the Middle East. Compiled business development resources for young entrepreneurs in Zambia. Drafted source descriptions in accessible language.

positions.title: SAAB Tutoring Program Director
positions.description: Supervised 60 employees of university tutoring program. Managed $17,000 budget.
